name: Kumasawa Himeno
source:
Despite her short, petite stature, Himeno posses superhuman strength. Wanting to use her powers for good, she always has her Tanabata Seven hero outfit to wear close at hand, as it's quite easy for her to break things without realizing it using only a small bit of her strength.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
